world: a species-accumulation curve flattening as a survey covers the habitat

name: viewfinder
does: States the frame of an analysis, what filters and date ranges kept inside and what was cropped out before it began.
world: a photographer's crop hiding what stands beside the frame

name: vol-targeting
does: scales a position so realized volatility lands near a target, using only past data with leverage cap and turnover report
world: a driver easing off the throttle as the road gets bumpier

name: walk-forward-split
does: Builds train and test splits for time-ordered data that cannot leak the future, using rolling windows with gaps and purged folds.
world: a student tested only on exam questions written after the textbook closed

name: watershed
does: splits a series into basins separated by its valleys
world: rain draining to separate river basins divided by ridges

name: wave-yield
does: Compares two library snapshots and reports births, deaths and merges to show what survived a culling wave.
world: a naturalist counting births and deaths in a herd across seasons

name: weak-assert-scan
does: scans test files for checks that can never fail or can pass for the wrong reason
world: an inspector finding a smoke alarm with the battery removed

name: weak-signal
does: Finds rarely used terms whose rate rose in the recent window against the baseline window, with a smoothed rate ratio.
world: early tremors or faint radio blips before a trend emerges

name: welford-stats
does: computes exact running count, mean, variance and extremes in one stable pass and merges partial results
world: a cashier tallying a running average without re-adding the whole day

name: windows-bypass-fixtures
does: Attacks a path, host or human check with platform-specific spoofed inputs to find ways around it.
world: a lockpicker trying every known trick on a door lock

name: windows-gotchas
does: collects hard-won platform hazards and lints commands for them, running a command only when it is safe
world: a travel guide warning of local pitfalls before you act

name: windows-port-audit
does: Finds platform-specific failures in code written elsewhere, such as encodings, line endings and path handling, before a long check finds them.
world: a customs inspector checking foreign goods against local plug and voltage standards

name: winners-curse
does: estimates the real spread among candidates and shrinks each toward the average to say what the winner will keep
world: the auction winner who overpaid because they had the highest estimate

name: word-sex
does: Breeds two words by crossing them at vowel seams and keeps only pronounceable new offspring.
world: a portmanteau like smog formed from smoke and fog

name: worms-eye
does: starts from the lowest step or leaf functions and lists upward what each must assume about everything above it
world: a worm looking up from the soil at all that rests on it

name: write-ahead-log
does: Keeps crash-safe state in an append-only log with sequence numbers and checksums, replaying cleanly up to any torn tail.
world: a ship's logbook written before each action so it can be reconstructed after a storm

name: write-only-log
does: scans code for every file written to and flags logs that nothing ever reads
world: a diary kept for years that no one ever opens

name: writer-pen
does: A one-writer lock for a shared repository: claim it, gate landings on the claim, release promptly and never force-release on a hunch.
world: a talking stick letting only one person speak at a time

name: x-ray
does: shows a text as a claim tree linking each claim to its supports and lists top claims left unsupported
world: an x-ray revealing the skeleton under the skin

name: zealot-eye
does: Rewrites each claim into its absolutist form and reports where the exaggerated claim breaks against counter-evidence in the same text.
world: a fanatic's overstatement exposed by a counterexample

name: zoom-ladder
does: views a series at doubling resolutions and lists which features appear or vanish at each level
world: zooming a map from street to continent watching details vanish

does: splits parallel work by role: many workers only compute and read, one writer applies every write
name: caste-split
world: a honeybee colony: thousands of foragers bring food home, one queen lays

name: decision-menu
does: turns the owner's open decisions into a menu: one plain sentence of meaning, what they actually do, NOW / LATER / DONE, the recommended default, and one reply line that answers everything
world: a waiter reading the whole menu to a hurried guest and naming the dish of the day
